subject: Dedicated capacity demo & pre-call: throughput / latency alignment
messages:
From: Alyssa Wong <alyssa@signalwave.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@signalwave.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Dedicated capacity demo (self-signup) — throughput targets attached

Hi Ben,

Thanks — I signed up through the self-serve flow earlier and selected a Dedicated capacity demo slot, but wanted to give a bit more context before the call. Our product is a real-time document classification pipeline and we expect bursty peaks during business hours. Key numbers below: 

- Expected sustained QPS: 1,200 requests/sec (mix of short and medium tokens)
- Peak QPS: 6,000 requests/sec (10–15 minute bursts)
- P95 latency target: <= 120ms per request (end-to-end)
- Average prompt length: ~120 tokens (mostly short instructions + payload)
- Embedding calls: occasional (not on hot path)

I attached a small spreadsheet with a sample traffic profile and a few example payloads (signalwave_capacity_v1.xlsx). We are in PDT (San Francisco) and the initial slot the self-signup offered is Wed 06/30 11:00 PDT — that works for Samir and me, but we also may need a short pre-call (15m) with an engineer to validate our assumptions.

Could you confirm who from Redwood will be on the call (ops/solutions) and whether we should expect any special testing steps/rate limits in the demo environment? Also, do you have a short precall checklist we can run through?

Appreciate it — Alyssa

Alyssa Wong
Head of ML Infrastructure
SignalWave Analytics

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Wong <alyssa@signalwave.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@signalwave.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated capacity demo (self-signup) — throughput targets attached

Hi Alyssa — great to see the signup, and thanks for the numbers + spreadsheet. I looped in Karthik (solutions engineering) who will join the main demo for capacity/latency tuning, and Marissa (customer success) will be on the follow-up to capture next steps.

We can do a short 15m pre-call with Karthik before the demo to validate traffic patterns and agree on a test harness. Proposed times (PDT):
- Wed 06/30 10:15–10:30 (before your 11:00 demo slot)
- Wed 06/30 09:00–09:15 (if you prefer earlier)

If neither works, propose a 10:45 pre-call and we’ll shift.

Quick asks for the pre-call so we can come prepared: 
- A small sample of request/response sizes (or a synthetic representative payload)
- Any IP allowlist requirements
- Whether embeddings are on the same path or separate

I attached a short precall checklist we run through (redwood_precall_checklist.pdf). Karthik — can you confirm whether the demo environment will support a short synthetic ramp to 4–5k QPS for short bursts? We’ll discuss fallback policies and batching options during the demo.

Thanks — Ben

Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Wong <alyssa@signalwave.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated capacity demo (self-signup) — throughput targets attached

Thanks Alyssa — looks helpful. I’ll be on the demo and happy to run the pre-call. A couple of engineering notes ahead of the 11:00 demo so we can use the time efficiently: 

1) Demo environment constraints
- We can run a synthetic ramp to ~5k QPS for 10–15 minute bursts in the sandbox; sustained 6k QPS for long periods needs a reserved pool sizing conversation (we can model a pilot).
- For accurate latency numbers, please confirm whether "P95 <= 120ms" is end-to-end (including network) or server-side only. If end-to-end, we’ll run tests from a closest-region probe.

2) Suggested pre-call checklist (quick)
- Confirm a representative JSON request (we need token counts and attachments stripped)
- Share IPs or VPC/VPN requirements if you need Private deployment testing
- Identify a success metric for the demo (e.g., p95 <= 180ms at 3k QPS)

3) Test plan we’ll run on the demo:
- Baseline single-request latency
- Controlled ramp to 3k QPS and observe p50/p95/p99
- Short burst test to 5k QPS for 10 minutes with KV cache warmed
- Configure and show autoscale/fallback behavior

Ben — I booked a 10:15–10:30 pre-call and left the original 11:00 demo slot as-is. Alyssa/Samir — if you can send a small sample payload (single request JSON) and confirm whether embeddings are hitting the same endpoint, that would be ideal.

On attachments: I’ll upload our demo harness notes to the shared HubSpot link so you can reference it after the call.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Wong <alyssa@signalwave.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@signalwave.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Dedicated capacity demo (self-signup) — throughput targets attached

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Ben and Karthik. The 10:15 pre-call is confirmed (Samir and I will join). I attached the single-request sample and a short notes tab in the spreadsheet with observed token counts. A few clarifications: 

- P95 target is end-to-end (client -> Redwood -> client)
- Embeddings are separate and not on the hot path — we can exclude them for the main ramp
- We do not need a Private deployment for the demo; public sandbox with IP allowlist is fine

Also looping in our procurement lead, Samir, in case we move quickly on pilot sizing. We may be interested in a small reserved pool pilot for predictable peaks. If the demo shows we can meet latency at 3k–4k sustained, we’ll request a pilot quote.

See you at 10:15.

Best,
Alyssa

--
Attachments:
- sample_request.json (attachment stub)
- signalwave_capacity_v1.xlsx (already shared)
